attestations.unique_hook_one_sentence: A living wasteland track that hunts you while you race combat rigs through Night Runs to buy freedom from dystopian overlords.

uniqueness_answers.differentiator: The track is a living predator — hazards move and target the player and change behavior mid-race (HOSTILE phase), not static obstacles like classic Twisted Metal or Mario Kart items.
uniqueness_answers.rejected_ai_suggestion: Pure weapon-arena deathmatch on a painted oval with static props (generic Twisted Metal clone).
uniqueness_answers.why_play_twice: 13 Night Run levels toward freedom from the dystopian overlords — scrap upgrades persist, lose and retry with a meaner build, later nights get harder, complete the ladder to escape.
